description: Check whether a Node3D is inside the camera's view (not behind it, projected inside the viewport) and where it lands on screen — the 3D judgement that otherwise needs a screenshot.

camera.description: Camera3D to use; default the active 3D camera.

node.description: Node in the running game: relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute (e.g. '/root/Main/Player'). Default: the running scene root (must be a Node3D).

name: game_in_view
title: Is a node on screen
